remarks: This wonderful ranch features a great open floor plan and traditional style rooms with an 3 season enclosed porch perfect for entertaining in your own private back yard! New kitchen with granite counter tops, custom cabinets finished with crown molding, and new stainless steel stove, dishwasher, and microwave.  The master bedroom includes a master half bath and custom closets! The basement offers additional square footage, and the attic is great for storage! With great curb appeal, the convenient location, and the recent renovations this home checks all the boxes!! Commuters take note - 2 miles to both the Westport Train Station and/or East Norwalk Train Station. Just a 5 minute walk to the elementary, middle, and high schools, and Close proximity to restaurants, shopping, parks and I-95.
